title: Soghra ke kaleijay par barchi si lagi hogi
body:
Soghra ke kaleijay par barchi si lagi hogi
Tasveer jo kunbey ki aankhoun main phiri hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Alfaaz nahin milthay, kis tarha bathaye hum
Abbas pe kya guzree, jab mashk chidi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas bacha lena, durroun sey Sakina ko
Sajjad ke paaoun mein, zanjeer bandhi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ka laasha bhi, beychaen huva hoga
Jab Saaniyeh Zehra ki, chaadar bhi chini hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekha hai Sakina ney phir, khwaab main Baba ko
Kya haal huva hoga, jab aankh khuli hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar ke lab-e-tashna, aankhoun main phirey hongay
Zindaan main Sakina ko, jab pyaas lagi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Lo aakhri pursa hai, ashkoun sey isey bhar doh
Rumaal liye Zehra, beychaen khadi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashkoun sey bhari aankhen, zakhmoun sey bhara seena
Mehshar main Nawaaz apni, pehchaan yehi hogi
